description: Return the full schema tree from the desktop app, with live-event statuses merged in, plus the current `revision` (pass it as expectedRevision on writes to detect stale reads). Long roadmaps can exceed the tool-result limit, so trim the answer: for a long roadmap or for polling, pass omitNotes: true and hideCompleted: true; to read one phase, pass rootId (that node's id) and depth. A stub is one line { id, title, status, type, childCount } standing in for a node whose children are left out; read those children with rootId set to the stub's id. Notes can also be fetched with getNode/findNodes. Requires the app to be running and a file to be loaded.

depth.description: Levels of children to keep below the top nodes (the rootId node, else the top-level nodes); the next level comes back as stubs. 0 = the top nodes only, their children as stubs.

hideCompleted.description: Show a node as a stub when it and everything under it is completed. A completed node with any open descendant stays in full.

omitNotes.description: Leave out notes and the createdAt/updatedAt timestamps.

rootId.description: Answer only this node and its subtree; the answer adds rootId and ancestorIds (root-to-parent). An unknown id gives node_not_found.

name: getRoadmap
title: Get the loaded RoadRaven roadmap
